verdict.rationale: Carta's API platform supports OAuth 2.0 with both CLIENT_CREDENTIALS and AUTHORIZATION_CODE grants, lets developers add specific OAuth scopes to an application, and supports separate service accounts for investor-side integrations — all of which enable issuing narrower, purpose-specific credentials rather than a single all-access key. However, there's no documentation of agent-specific least-privilege tooling (e.g., per-agent scoped tokens, fine-grained revocation/rotation, or scoping guidance tailored to AI agents) beyond generic OAuth scope management. Missing for 10: agent-specific credential provisioning workflow, granular scope catalog with least-privilege guidance, and credential revocation/audit controls.
